*706Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit granted.

Acting Solicitor General Judson for respondents. Mr. Wayne M. Collins filed a brief on behalf of the Northern and Southern California Branches of the American Civil Liberties Union, as amici curiae, in support of the petition.
